mapping.identity: Source-locator IDs, not native engineering-project IDs. Feeder/circuit numbers are asset references; separate islands can reuse feeder labels.
mapping.owner: WAPA is publisher/operator/project sponsor. No per-package sole asset-owner rule established; all qualified owners null. Contractors/funding agencies are not owners.
mapping.spatial: No native coordinates in selected text. Island names, affected communities and line references remain source context, never inferred centers or geometry.
mapping.voltage: No continental cutoff. Only the PDF expressly labelled transmission entry and the dated overhead-transmission description qualify as transmission. Mixed substations, poles and undergrounding remain context; normalized voltage unknown.
mapping.dates: Target end means project completion, kind unknown. Preserve month/day precision. Invalid11/31/2023 stays unknown. Project-start and design-RFP-start dates are not construction starts. Shared2026 outage nights do not establish per-project in-service dates or windows.
mapping.status: P.6 installed-versus-total poles establishes partial physical work as of August2023. P.7 unqualified project percentages retain unknown lifecycle; DesignRFP is planned. Upcoming p.8 and scheduled remaining2026 work are planned in their respective evidence context, not current confirmations.
mapping.overlap: Keep Ridge Road separate from transmission lines in the slide. Never equate 2023 entries with2026 named work without engineering identity evidence; do not duplicate current web-page descriptions or program headings.
mapping.geography: Multi-island partial scope: St.Thomas, St.John, St.Croix and a completed Water Island package. This is not one connected nationwide grid or territory-wide completeness.

actualGaps: No current complete WAPA project register or identity crosswalk between legacy recovery packages and2026 projects.
No verified publication/as-of date for p.7–8 of the legacy deck; snapshot observation must not imply current status.
No native geometry or qualified per-project owner evidence.
Invalid EastEnd target and ambiguous completion percentages require source clarification; public contact was not attempted.
enablingInput: A public current WAPA capital/transmission project register with per-package status date, native work ID, explicit transmission/distribution role, and linkage to legacy recovery scopes would permit authoritative refresh and deduplication.

sourcePass.method: Public web text/downloads and PDF text/object extraction only; no rendering/screenshots/browser automation, restricted sources, external contact or producer/checks.
